description: Land Acquisition - Hehiella, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amendment to the Extra Gazette No. 2021/5 of 29.05.2017 - Ambalanpitiya, Kurunegala D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices about specific parcels of land being acquired by the government for public purposes, including descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, claimants, and details about compensation claims. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette (Type 4).
